question: Can distinct reduced generator images be lifted to nonisomorphic rank-one rational curves with good reduction on the eight-field panel?
fields: all eight selected primes in frozen input order
generator: G=m(2,2) mod p, m=ord((2,2) mod p)/q
candidate_reduced_points: uG for u=1,2,3 in that order
lift: center each affine x,y in [-p/2,p/2], then B=y^2-x^3+x and E/Q:y^2=x^3-x+B with P=(x,y)
rank_test: Sage E.rank(proof=True), retaining errors and timeouts; torsion_subgroup().order() exact
claim_boundary: rank-one admission only for rows with proved rank one and verified generator status; other rows remain rank-unknown or higher-rank diagnostics
